description: Archive queue sections from task state: a section closes when every task row has a terminal state file, at any heading level.
delta: The worktree-lifecycle block replaces the conservative queue-section archival text with the state-based rule: a section that lists task rows closes when every row's state file is terminal (DONE in Lean Delivery; ACCEPTED, ANSWERED, or INCONCLUSIVE in Governed SDD), at any heading level and whatever the table shape; a row without a state file keeps the `###` table rule and a mixed section needs both rules to agree. The adoption text names `meridian task state import --include-terminal` and that integrate stage reports every archived and retained section. No gate is relaxed and INCONCLUSIVE still does not satisfy a dependency.
upgradeNotes: Run upgrade --apply to install the state-based queue archival rule in docs/WORKTREE_LIFECYCLE.md; adapted archival text may conflict. Then run `meridian task state import --include-terminal` to preview state for terminal legacy tasks and repeat with --apply so their sections archive by state. No protocolVersion change.
verification: A section whose task rows all have terminal state files archives at any heading level, and an INCONCLUSIVE spike closes its section.
A project without state files archives exactly as before, and integrate stage reports every archived and retained section with its reason.
